title: Tracing out massive fields in cosmology
summary: Cosmological correlators are calculated through the in-in formalism in (quasi-)de Sitter background. Its effective description is best represented by a reduced density matrix. In this work, we study how integrating out a massive field in de Sitter space determines the reduced density matrix of a light field at a finite observation time. Starting from a quasi-single-field model with non-linear couplings, we first evaluate the massive field wavefunctional at fixed final value and then trace over this value.
